messages:
maria_marketing: Quick heads-up — want to produce a short customer story for CanvasAI focused on latency/cost wins. Need interview, pull quotes, legal clearance, and a launch asset bundle. Who can own the orchestration?

alex_content: I can run the interview and draft the narrative. timeline?

maria_marketing: Goal: soft launch w/ blog + tweet thread + 1 pager in 3 weeks. Interview this week if possible.

lindsay_pm: Pinged the CanvasAI contact, Daniel. He said Tue/Thu mornings ET work.

alex_content: Tue 10am ET works for me. Can I get product context — numbers on latency/cost from runtime team?

maria_marketing: Lindsay has the baseline perf slides. I'll drop a link after sync. Need the numbers to shape the headline.

lindsay_pm: Here — notes from the perf review: "~3.7x throughput improvement, 42% cost reduction on average across inference workloads". Putting into Drive: https://redwood.work/drive/canvasai-perf (internal)

alex_content: Perfect. Drafting Qs. Short interview (15m) + request 2-3 sentence quote for marketing.

sam_legal: Quick note — CanvasAI has a partner NDA that mentions quote approvals. We need their sign-off on final quote and permission to use company name/logo. Also check for any data mentions.

maria_marketing: Good call. Lindsay, can you confirm NDA status and whether logo assets are ok to use?

lindsay_pm: NDA signed last quarter, but it's the basic partnership NDA. I'll confirm logo usage and whether they want review before publish.

jordan_sales: Also flagging inbound routing — can ops route demo requests triggered by the story to my team? We should have a lead tag for "CanvasAI-customerstory".

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "CanvasAI interview prep" Tue 10:00 ET (in 48 hours) — msg sent to participants. :alarm_clock:

alex_content: Draft interview script below — please edit.

```
1) Quick intro & product role in stack
2) Specific metrics you measured after migrating to Redwood Inference
3) Which features mattered most (batching, quant, KV cache)
4) Short quote we can use in the blog (2-3 sentences)
5) Any customer-facing tips for teams evaluating inference platforms
```

sam_legal: Add to #3: avoid any mention of underlying cloud provider names (customer policy). Also request explicit written sign-off on the final quote.

tess_design: I can mock a hero asset and 1-pager layout once Alex has the headline. Timeline: 4 days for initial comps.

maria_marketing: Plan: Interview Tue, Alex drafts blog by Fri, legal sign-off early next week, design assets next Wed, publish target Mon (3 weeks out). Is everyone okay with that cadence?

jordan_sales: Works for sales. I'll prep a routing rule: any demo request with subject containing "CanvasAI" -> Jordan queue + tag. Also want a short playbook snippet for AE follow-up.

sam_legal: When Alex posts draft, please @me with the quote block. I will either approve or provide redlines within 48 hours.

alex_content: Noted. I'll capture the quote in a separate block for quick review. Also planning a 1-line social card + 3 tweet thread.

maria_marketing: Small ask for interview: can we get one metric screenshot (dashboard) and one exec headshot? Daniel said yes to both but will confirm.

lindsay_pm: Confirmed — Daniel can provide a dashboard screenshot and a headshot. He asked we anonymize any PII in the screenshot.

alex_content: Draft outreach to Daniel (sending now):

```
Hi Daniel — thanks again for the chat. Quick ask: could you review the attached 2-3 sentence quote and confirm logo usage? We'll send final copy for your approval before publish. Appreciate it! — Alex
```

maria_marketing: Nice. After publish: Jordan, can you update the lead playbook and send a short nurture sequence?

jordan_sales: Yep — I'll prepare a 3-email cadence and a demo link.

ops-bot: Action created: "Collect CanvasAI quote approval" assigned to sam_legal — due 1956005500.

sam_legal: I'll triage when draft is in. If anything looks like a claim (e.g., exact % savings), we may ask for a signed attestation or link to internal report.

maria_marketing: Thanks team — I'll own the schedule and keep folks looped. Alex, let me know when the draft is ready for legal.

alex_content: Will post draft in this thread after the call.

maria_marketing: Closing note — avoid overly technical benchmarking jargon in the public narrative; focus on business impact. :sparkles:

alex_content: Got it. Short, punchy, data-backed.

ops-bot: Thread closed by schedule: publish window set for 1956600000.
